answer: Standing accrues only through bonds a challenger may seize after proving an identity duplicate, so cloning yourself costs more than cooperating. Each newcomer must also submit a live single-use reading — a willow's sap flow, a juniper's soil moisture, a river's turbidity — signed by unclonable hardware, binding one identity to one physical claim. A sybil farm pays bond and sensor cost per puppet; the thousandth fake outruns the first's reward.
